prompt_text: I need a personal injury attorney in Chicago after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
I can recommend several Chicago-area personal injury firms that handle car-accident cases and explain why each is worth calling. If you want, tell me a few quick facts about your crash (date, injuries, fault, police report, insurer contact) and I’ll prioritize which firms are best for your situation.

Top Chicago firms to call and why

- Clifford Law Offices (Chicago)
  - Why call: Nationally known Chicago plaintiff firm that focuses on catastrophic auto, wrongful death, and serious-injury cases. Strong trial and settlement track record for high-value/difficult cases.
  - Good if: You or a loved one suffered serious, permanent, or fatal injuries.

- Levin & Perconti
  - Why call: Long-established Chicago personal injury firm with many high-value settlements and experience against big insurers and hospitals. Handles auto collisions, traumatic brain injury, and wrongful death.
  - Good if: Complex injuries or disputes over fault/insurance coverage.

- Corboy & Demetrio
  - Why call: Large Chicago trial firm focused on plaintiff personal injury, including car crashes and catastrophic injuries. Known for aggressive litigation when insurers won’t offer fair value.
  - Good if: You expect the insurer to fight liability or value.

- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.
  - Why call: Regional plaintiff firm with a strong Chicago presence, experienced in auto collisions and serious-injury claims. Offers contingency representation and takes cases to trial when needed.
  - Good if: You want an established local firm with plaintiff-focused experience.

- Goldberg Weisman Cairo (GWC)
  - Why call: Chicago-area personal injury firm that handles auto accidents, bicycle/pedestrian collisions, and serious-injury claims. Good local reputation and hands-on client service.
  - Good if: You want a respected local firm with experience across common crash scenarios.

- Power Rogers & Smith LLP
  - Why call: Illinois trial lawyers with experience in auto accident and injury litigation, handling claims against insurers and large defendants.
  - Good if: You want a firm experienced in courtroom litigation and settlement negotiations.

How to decide which to call first
- Prioritize firms that handle cases like yours (catastrophic vs. minor injuries; wrongful death; pedestrian/bike crash).
- Call 3–4 firms for free consultations and compare:
  - Who will handle the case day-to-day (partner vs. associate)
  - Their experience with cases like yours and typical outcomes
  - Whether they handle medical liens or expect you to pay costs upfront
  - Fee structure (common contingency is 33–40% plus costs) and any capped expenses
  - Whether they will take the case to trial if needed

What to ask right away on the call
- Do you handle car-accident cases like mine? How long have you been doing it?
- Who in your office will handle the case, and how accessible are they?
- What is your contingency fee and who pays case costs?
- Estimated timeline and possible settlement range for cases like mine.
- Do you have experience dealing with my insurer or the at-fault party?

Immediate steps to protect your claim
- Get medical care and follow treatment recommendations.
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report number, witness names.
- Do not sign releases or give recorded statements to the other side or the insurer without talking to an attorney first.
- Keep a damage/injury diary (symptoms, bills, missed work).

If you want, tell me:
- Brief details (date, injuries, who’s at fault, whether police/ambulance were involved), and I’ll suggest which two or three of the firms above are the best first calls and draft a short script you can use when you call.
